name: ModelVariant78_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant78_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a 13x13 grid of Gouraud-shaded quads waves and scrolls in front of the slot while the model's ambient light dims; a textured ring then sways and bounces with 34 sprites orbiting it, 32 sprites rise from around the opposing slot, and the light is restored at the end); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-95/225 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
